dedupe_keys.name: departement des cotes d armor cycling and walking datasets

description: Département des Côtes d'Armor: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Côtes d'Armor. Coverage: Département des Côtes d'Armor. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aménagements cyclables dans les Côtes d'Armor (selon le schéma BNAC); Schéma Vélo des Côtes d'Armor; Inventaire des équipements sur les voies vertes costarmoricaines du sc; Fréquentation piétonne du site de l'Abbaye de Bon Repos. Formats seen: URL, CSV, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence), as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
